verdict.rationale: Elicit does offer a documented API and MCP server exposing search and full systematic-review workflows (elicit-docs-34, -35, -36), which covers some UI functionality programmatically. However, the docs describe only search and systematic-review as API/MCP capabilities, with no evidence that Research Agent chat, skills, columns, collaboration, alerts, or library/export management are accessible via API—so parity with the UI is only partial. Missing for 10: API/MCP coverage of Research Agent conversations, skills, collaboration features, alerts, and full export/library management; independent confirmation that API output matches UI capability set.
